Sigmainfo: Magesh R, Sonam Dahake, Sandeep Phophaliya, to: Shiresha Madhury
Key Takeaways
Monitoring website errors and mobile load times remains a priority, with discussions on JavaScript/CSS warnings and improvements needed to enhance LCP and overall user experience.
Traffic and lead tracking require immediate attention, with a request for full access to funnel reports and event data for accurate performance analysis.
Custom views in Google Analytics were discussed to filter out India traffic, ensuring that the team obtains more relevant market insights.
Image resolution issues in the AI chatbot blog were highlighted, with feedback noting stretched and blurry visuals that require immediate fixes.
Updated blog categorization, tags, and block topics were emphasized to align content with prioritized search queries for October.

Current Workflow
WordPress is used to update blog posts, categories, and tags; 260 blogs are being reworked with 107 initial categories reduced to 9 unique ones.
A caching/optimization plugin is used for compressing and minifying CSS and JS, which generates new URLs on cache clear.
Pain Points
Persistent JavaScript and CSS warnings are being reported due to the caching plugin, potentially impacting SEO.
Images in the AI chatbot blog appear stretched and blurry when resolution changes are applied.
Inefficiencies Observed
The caching plugin behavior, which regenerates URLs upon cache clear, is causing repeated warnings and potential false 404 errors in reports.
Key Stakeholders
Mukul M and Samarpith Rout lead technical discussions and analytics review regarding caching issues and query performance.
Magesh R confirms plugin usage and working on performance improvements, including mobile page load enhancements.
Shiresha Madhury coordinates the meeting and requests timely edits on the content blocks and categories.
Sandeep Phophaliya is involved in traffic and lead reporting and asks for funnel/report access enhancements.
Tools / Systems Used
WordPress is used for blog updates and category management.
Google Search Console, Semrush, and Screaming Frog are utilized for crawling audits and error monitoring.
Google Analytics 4 and custom filters in Search Console are used for traffic and region-specific reporting.
Google AI Studio is being leveraged for generating images for the AI chatbot blog.
Root Causes Identified
Caching plugin regenerates URLs on cache clear, leading to old URLs being crawled and reported as warnings though not causing real-time errors.
Screaming Frog reports persistent crawling issues that do not appear in Google Search Console, suggesting tool-specific false positives.
Proposed Improvements
Raise a support ticket regarding the caching plugin warnings to seek a solution, potentially involving cache clearing or plugin update.
Complete blog category updates and tag assignments, ensuring new blogs adhere to the optimized categorization.
Improve image resolution for AI chatbot blogs to avoid stretched and blurry visuals.
Implement improvements on mobile page load times, with backend server adjustments in progress.
Impact
Improving mobile load times and resolving caching plugin warnings should reduce potential SEO penalties and user experience issues.
Proper blog categorization and tag updates are expected to enhance SEO performance and lead generation.
Metrics
Out of an initial 107 blog categories, the count is reduced to 9 unique categories with half of the blogs already updated.
Traffic data shows approximately 90% of visits from India and increased impressions in the US.
Mobile performance metrics include an LCP of around 2.9 seconds and an FCP of 15.4 seconds on the homepage.
Risk
Unresolved caching plugin warnings may impact SEO if new errors emerge or older URLs are not correctly purged.
Slow mobile page load times could negatively affect user experience and conversion rates.
Technical Audit Outcomes
Caching plugin issues are generating outdated JS/CSS warnings without causing real 404 errors; robots.txt fixes and removal of extra sitemaps have resolved crawling issues.
Content Strategy for Keyword Optimization
Blog categories streamlined from 107 duplicates to 9 unique ones with half of the blogs updated; block topics based on top keyword queries are planned.
Blog Optimization Strategies
Enhance blog categorization by updating old posts with 9 refined categories and ensure new blogs use these sorted tags and categories.
Tracking of monthly and weekly performance reports is set to provide visibility on keyword performance, impressions, and lead generation.
Plan content around top performing queries and block topics from monthly reports to drive targeted traffic and leads.
Traffic Analysis and Reporting
Monthly traffic report for September will be compiled by Mukul M by the weekend/early next week; funnel report access pending.
Seasonal Content Planning
Content planning will leverage seasonal trends with topics for Black Friday, Cyber Monday, and ecommerce holiday campaigns.
Website Performance Issues
Mobile blog pages experience slow loading with LCP 2.9s and FCP 15.4s; server-level improvements underway.
